title: Find users located in the United Kingdom who have posted at least one quest
question: Find users located in the United Kingdom who have posted at least one question with a favorite count of 5 or more and have fewer than 5 downvotes. For these users, compute the total number of comments across all their posts, the average score of their posts, and the total view count, grouped by their display name. Only include users whose total post view count exceeds 1000.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
    COUNT(c."XCL_005") AS total_comments,
    AVG(p."XCL_031") AS avg_score,
    SUM(p."XCL_030") AS total_view_count
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
WHERE u."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom'
  AND u."XCL_052" IN (
      SELECT p2."XCL_033"
      FROM posts p2
      WHERE p2."XCL_027" = 1
        AND p2."XCL_039" >= 5
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v."XCL_067" = p2."XCL_026" AND v."XCL_068" = 25) < 5
  )
GROUP BY u."XCL_055"
HAVING SUM(p."XCL_030") > 1000

SELECT
    u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
    COUNT(c."XCL_005") AS total_comments,
    AVG(p."XCL_031") AS avg_score,
    SUM(p."XCL_030") AS total_view_count
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
WHERE u."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom'
  AND u."XCL_052" IN (
      SELECT p2."XCL_033"
      FROM posts p2
      WHERE p2."XCL_027" = 1
        AND p2."XCL_039" >= 5
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v."XCL_067" = p2."XCL_026" AND v."XCL_068" = 25) < 5
  )
GROUP BY u."XCL_055"
HAVING SUM(p."XCL_030") > 1000
